description.value: Ricky's All Day Grill is a Canadian family restaurant chain with over 60 years of history, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner all day from a sit-down dining room. The Nanaimo location sits along Island Highway North, a primary cycling corridor on Vancouver Island. The menu spans all-day breakfast classics and Eggs Benedict through to Alberta Angus beef burgers, comfort mains, and Fish & Chips.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ricky's All Day Grill is an active Canadian chain with Nanaimo locations listed (shown as 'Nanaimo North' and 'Nanaimo South' on the menus/locations page), and explicitly advertises takeout and delivery service. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null.
